raw_segments.text: The same order of people are, by the same law, prohibited from wearing hoes, of which
the price should exceed fourteen pence the pair, equal to about eight ten twenty pence
But fourteen pence was in those times the price of a bushel and near two pecks of wheat,
which in the present times, at three and six pence the bushel, would cost five shillings
We should in the present times consider this as a very high price for a pair of stockings
to a servant of the poorest and lowest order.
He must, however, in those times, have paid what was really equivalent to this price for them.
